Challenges

Sound familiar?

“Our videos get uploaded and then disappear.”

Without packaging and metadata built for search and suggested traffic, even good videos have no discovery path. The channel audit finds where each video is failing.

“Views are fine but nobody watches past a minute.”

Retention is planned, not hoped for: hooks, chapters and pacing are designed from your audience data before filming, not after.

“Thumbnails are whatever the editor had time for.”

Thumbnails are ranking assets. Guidelines and testing turn them into the click-through engine the algorithm rewards.

“We copy competitors’ topics and still lose.”

Topic selection comes from search demand and competitor gaps — not from copying what already ranked for someone else.

“Subscribers grow but leads don’t.”

Channel strategy connects videos to offers: playlists, end screens and descriptions built as a funnel, not a dumping ground.

“Old videos could work harder but nobody touches them.”

Back-catalogue optimisation — titles, thumbnails, descriptions, playlists — often unlocks growth faster than new uploads.

“Shorts and long-form fight each other.”

Formats get one calendar and one strategy, with Shorts feeding the long-form catalogue instead of competing with it.

“Analytics might as well be in another language.”

Monthly reports translate watch time, CTR and traffic sources into the next month’s decisions — in plain language.

Why Us

Why channels grow with us

Packaging-first

Titles and thumbnails are treated as the ranking assets they are — researched, designed and tested.

Retention-aware planning

Hooks, chapters and pacing are planned from audience data before a camera rolls.

Search + suggested, together

Both discovery systems are optimised as one strategy, because YouTube feeds on both.

Back catalogue included

Existing videos are re-packaged and re-structured, not ignored in favour of new uploads.

Funnel thinking

Playlists, end screens and descriptions connect viewing to subscribing to enquiring.

Readable reporting

How It Works

Two algorithms, one strategy

YouTube discovery works through search rankings and the recommendation engine, and both feed on the same signals: click-through rate, retention and session time. Pretty videos with weak packaging go nowhere.

We research what your audience searches, engineer titles and thumbnails for the click, structure videos for retention, and organise channels so every upload lifts the back catalogue too.

  • Channel audit
  • Video keyword & topic plan
  • Title & thumbnail guidelines
  • Optimised descriptions set
  • Playlist structure
  • Monthly analytics reports

FAQs

FAQs on YouTube SEO services

Do you produce the videos?

We handle strategy, packaging and optimisation; filming can be yours or arranged through partners.

How fast does YouTube SEO work?

Re-packaged back-catalogue videos can lift within weeks; channel-level growth compounds over quarters.

Can you optimise Shorts too?

Yes — Shorts strategy is included, tuned for discovery and funneling viewers to long-form.

What metrics do you report?

Impressions, CTR, watch time, subscribers and traffic driven to your site.
